answer: Give every identity recurring, non-transferable upkeep duty: after each epoch opens, it receives a unique bundle of small verification jobs, rechecking random receipts and sampling one peer, due within hours. One agent can wander the tide of tasks for a few identities, but a sybil island of thousands owes thousands of distinct, cross-checked bundles, and each missed or botched bundle pauses earnings. Farming stops scaling because the work owed grows exactly with headcount and cannot be templated away.
